text: それ　あずけたら　こまるん　ちゃう？

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if that happens'. あずけたら = 'if you deposit it'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.explanation: んちゃう is the Kansai dialect way of saying んじゃない, which asks 'isn't it so?' when you think it is. こまるんちゃう = 'won't you be in trouble?'
